letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai whispers your name, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad carries my love back to you. Today feels like the perfect blend of sand and spice, reminding me how our hearts have woven two homes into one endless adventure. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my daily sunrise. I’m forever grateful for the cutie who turned ordinary moments into golden memories. Here’s to countless more chapters, hand‑in‑hand, heart‑to‑heart.
poem:
Across the dunes and mango trees we roam,  
Your love’s the compass that guides me home.  
In every sunset, pink or gold,  
Our story shines, forever told.
